label: Interactions (incl. Lotka–Volterra)
text: BI.O.A5.2 Interactions. Classified by the sign of the effect on each party: competition (−/−), predation and parasitism (+/−), mutualism (+/+), commensalism (+/0), amensalism (−/0), and neutralism (0/0) as the null. The Lotka–Volterra predator–prey equations assume a well-mixed system, exponential prey growth without predators, and linear functional responses. The equation is owned here; its simulation is BI.M.4.

warrant.standard: Replicated field or mesocosm experiment; time series with stated uncertainty
warrant.defeaters: Pseudoreplication; scale mismatch; confounded gradients; detection bias
